name: allura-governance
description: Enforces Allura's 6 non-negotiable invariants via PreToolCall blocks, PostToolCall receipts, and always-on context injection. Prevents docker exec, append-only violations, missing group_id, unauthorized Neo4j mutations, and unapproved promotions.

interface.shortDescription: Hard enforcement of Allura's 6 invariants on every tool call.
interface.longDescription: Allura Governance runs on every tool call in Claude Code. PreToolCall hooks block docker exec, append-only violations, missing group_id, unauthorized Neo4j mutations, and unapproved memory promotions before they execute. PostToolCall hooks inject write receipt reminders. UserPromptSubmit injects governance rules whenever DB or memory work is detected.
defaultPrompt: Check what governance rules apply to this task.
Why was my tool call blocked?
